correctness.rationale: The mathematical finding is true. Summing over residues forces size h=m/2, and at nonzero characters the complement negates the indicator transform. At even frequencies the h-multiplied frequency is zero; at odd frequencies it is h. Hence either the parity coefficient vanishes or all odd coefficients vanish, the latter exactly equivalent to half-turn invariance. The first alternative and the half-turn pairing each force h even. For the labeled intersection, the half-turn pairs are parity homogeneous when h is even, and parity balance requires choosing m/8 pairs of each parity. For Burnside, a translation with gcd(s,m)=g fixes precisely the subsets lifted from residues modulo g; a size-h lift requires g even, and then parity balance requires g divisible by 4. Jointly imposing the half-turn replaces g by gcd(s,h), with twice the totient multiplicity. This recovers all three sums, including the identity and half-turn shifts and the small modulus edge cases. RESULT.md line 50 has a false redundant aside about even orbit lengths (e.g., s=2 modulo 8 has orbit length 4); the direct gcd reasoning there proves the claim without it. The finite evidence in VERIFICATION.md is recorded corroboration only; verify.py was inspected, not executed.
